title: Nick Drake: Pink Moon
description: His last album: under half an hour of voice and guitar, and one of the most haunting records ever made.

cards.prompt: In what year was Pink Moon released?
cards.details: It came out not long after Bryter Layter, and was the last album released in his lifetime.

cards.prompt: Roughly how many minutes long is Pink Moon?
cards.details: Eleven songs in under half an hour. Not a second is wasted.

cards.prompt: Apart from a single overdub, Pink Moon is just Drake's voice and which instrument?
cards.details: After the lush arrangements of his first two albums, he chose to strip everything away.

cards.prompt: Which instrument is overdubbed on the title track, the only addition on the album?
cards.details: A few simple piano notes, the album's one bit of decoration.

cards.prompt: Which engineer recorded Pink Moon with Drake in just two late-night sessions?
cards.details: Wood had engineered Drake's earlier albums. This time it was just the two of them in the studio.

cards.prompt: According to a famous story, where did Drake leave the Pink Moon master tapes?
cards.details: The legend is that he dropped them off without a word. The details vary in the telling, but the image stuck.
The same song used in that famous 2000 Volkswagen advert. See the artist set.

cards.prompt: Which Pink Moon song title is a phrase for a place where you belong?
cards.details: A short, aching song about feeling older and more worn than your years.

cards.prompt: Which Pink Moon song title refers to everything hidden from the light, "___ Behind the Sun"?
cards.details: "Things Behind the Sun" is one of the album's longest and most intricate guitar pieces.

cards.prompt: Which Pink Moon song title names an organism that lives off another?
cards.details: One of the album's darkest, most self-critical songs.

cards.prompt: What is the closing track of Pink Moon?
cards.details: A rare hopeful ending. A line from it, "now we rise and we are everywhere", is inscribed on his gravestone.
